question: Does Bayesian Dir-Multinomial K=12 (and K=24 if state space larger) with exact Gamma-ratio gammaln/polygamma bias correction and trajectory-grouped permutation (unit trajectory_id 1000-1999 perms, seed 42, |perm-analytic|<0.03, |null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01) detect action-conditioned structure beyond memory on real BrowserGym trajectories (WebShop/TodoMVC at locked 1280x720 CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree with genuine DOM visual bbox, computed style 8 values, AX embedding - not SHA256 hash-truncated) via relative separation (observed log BF exceeds 1999 shuffled null by >=200 nats, p_bonf<0.01) and gap >=0.05 over B-DOM-SIMILARITY TF-IDF k5 and B-MARKOV-1, where independent-noise control remains BC~0 (|BC|<0.05 p>0.10) and analytic null remains centered, reporting absolute BF (expected -10 to -15 nats favoring memory) separately as exploratory, thereby testing whether real Web shows any action-conditioned relative signal without requiring new Gate0 SPAs (titles>=2 H>0.2 leakage<40%)?
hypothesis: H1 (alternative): On real BrowserGym trajectories (WebShop and TodoMVC at locked 1280x720 via CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree with genuine DOM: visual bbox x,y,w,h quantized + element_count/tree_depth/interactive_density, computed style 8-value getComputedStyle {color,backgroundColor,visibility,display,opacity,border,position,fontSize}, AX-tree serialized role/name/value embeddings up to 5k, and event n-grams — not SHA256 hash-truncated single-value labels), the Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial K=12 (K=24 exploratory if |S_next|>=16 or state cardinality >12) with exact Gamma-ratio gammaln/polygamma bias correction and trajectory-grouped permutation (unit trajectory_id, 1000-1999 perms, seed 42) detects action-conditioned structure beyond memory via RELATIVE separation: observed log BF exceeds the 1999 shuffled null distribution by >=200 nats with p_bonf<0.01 (n_tests<=8, Bonferroni floor 0.0005), |perm_mean - analytic_mean|<0.03, |null_mean|<0.1 nats, calibrated null_std>0.01, and gap >=0.05 nats over B-DOM-SIMILARITY TF-IDF k=5 and B-MARKOV-1 baselines, while independent-noise genuine-DOM control remains BC~0 (|BC|<0.05 p>0.10) and analytic null remains centered (|analytic_mean|<0.1). Absolute BF is expected -10 to -15 nats favoring memory (M0) at K=12 on real TodoMVC (EXP-PHYSICS-35651906573 REVISE) and is reported exploratory only, not gating. H0 (null): No R achieves relative separation >=200 nats with p_bonf<0.01 and gap>=0.05 under valid centering/consistency and independent~0.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if with all validity gates passing (|analytic_mean|<0.1, calibrated_std valid >0.005 analytic or >0.01 perm, consistency |perm-analytic|<0.03, trajectory_id grouping, TRAIN-only fits, locked 1280x720 with genuine dom_bytes/a11y_bytes>0 and visual bbox+computed 8-value+AX embedding preserved, independent-noise |BC|<0.05 p>0.10) FORALL tested real-Web representations (primary K12, exploratory K24 if triggered) the relative signal fails: (observed - perm_median <200 nats) OR p_bonf>=0.01 OR gap <0.05 over both baselines, while gates pass and positive synthetic control passes (synthetic 12-state SPA observed 168-643 nats > null median -78 to -131 p=0.0005). Bounded to N=1000-1999 real BrowserGym trajectory bank at locked 1280x720 with genuine overlapping DOM. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST only if EXISTS real-Web bank with valid gates and relative sep >=200 p_bonf<0.01 and gap>=0.05 and independent~0 and analytic centered. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any gate fails: positive synthetic BC not >>0 or p>=0.001 or |analytic_mean|>=0.1, or independent shows |BC|>=0.05 p<0.10 valid, or |perm-analytic|>=0.03 on primary, or calibrated_std degenerate (analytic_std<=0.005 and perm_std<=0.01), or viewport/DOM verification fails, or N<100 or H(S_next|C)<=0.05 degenerate ceiling, or resampling not trajectory_id, or TRAIN leakage.

baselines.description: Ordinary-similarity null: TF-IDF cosine k=5 over genuine DOM text (visual text+bbox tokens + AX name/role tokens) fit on TRAIN trajectories only (70/30 split by trajectory_id). For each test state, predict S_next via 5-NN majority without stratification; compute bias-corrected score BC_sim via same exact Gamma-ratio Dirichlet-Multinomial K analytic+perm (gammaln/polygamma, alpha=1/K) grouped by trajectory_id. Report BC_sim, p_bonf, |analytic_mean|, consistency. Primary must exceed by gap >=0.05 nats. Miscentered baseline |analytic_mean|>=0.1 invalidates gap (audit 0.133>0.1 parent). Stable identity: B-DOM-SIMILARITY.
baselines.expected: BC_sim ~0.02-0.16 nats/bias if similarity captures signal; primary gap 0.011 in prior barrier shows similarity-like ceiling; |analytic_mean|<0.1 cons<0.03 required

baselines.description: First-order Markov memory null: P(S_next | S_current, A_leakageFree) MLE on TRAIN grouped by trajectory_id without DOM/history. Compute BC_markov1 via same exact analytic DM K and 1999 trajectory-grouped perms. Reports BC, p, |analytic_mean|, consistency. Primary gap >=0.05 nats required.
baselines.expected: BC_markov1 approx -0.003 to 0.02 on TodoMVC deterministic; gap isolates beyond-Markov DOM signal

baselines.description: History memory null: P(S_next | S_current, H_K=3) stratified majority (S_current, last 3 actions/states). Reports BC_hist, accuracy, H(S_next|C). Verifies H>0.05 not degenerate; 0.0 bits when K3 sufficient is memory compression not beyond-memory failure. Not gating but diagnostic.
baselines.expected: H(S_next|C) often 0.4-2.3 bits real SPAs; BC_hist near 0 when history sufficient

baselines.description: Trajectory-grouped permutation null: 1000-1999 within-strata shuffles of genuine DOM/action labels grouped by trajectory_id seed 42 => perm mean/std/p_raw/p_bonf (n_tests<=8, Bonferroni). Exact Gamma-ratio analytic mean/std via gammaln/polygamma compared for |perm-analytic|<0.03 and |analytic_mean|<0.1. Trajectory_id unit, no Gaussian jitter.
baselines.expected: perm_mean approx -25 to -40 nats on real TodoMVC (EXP-PHYSICS-35651906573), analytic_mean within 0.03 of perm_mean, |mean|<0.1 after bias correction? Note Bayesian nats scale: analytic_mean for BF is negative large; centering check is on BC=obs-analytic, not raw BF. For BF, |analytic_mean| check is on BC scale after correction.

baselines.description: Recalibrated null with same genuine capture: independent per-step genuine DOM variants (>=6 variants/state) captured via same 1280x720 CDP but regime-independent sampling (same overlapping spectra, within-trajectory action shuffle destroying action-state dependence, not S_current%2), identical exact DM + grouped perms N=1000-1999 seed 42. Must show BC~0 |BC|<0.05 nats p>0.10 |analytic_mean|<0.1. Confounding triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
baselines.expected: |BC|<0.05 p>0.10 valid; prior independent BC -0.029 p 1.0 valid on overlapping proxy

baselines.description: IID synthetic null: i.i.d. S_next independent of DOM/action with same marginal P(S), genuine DOM still sampled but S_next independent seed 42. Must show |BC|<=0.05 p>0.10 |analytic_mean|<0.1. Verifies null calibration independent of trajectory structure.

positive_control: Synthetic 12-state stochastic hash-routed SPA (same design as EXP-PHYSICS-35578258358 and EXP-PHYSICS-35651906573 positive control): 12 states, 4 candidates per (state,action), 50% hash routing +50% uniform random, N=5000 transitions (50 sessions x100 steps) seed 42. Known to pass Bayesian DM K=12 at all alpha_prior {0.5,1.0,2.0}: observed 167.9-643.1 nats, null_median -78 to -131 nats, null_max -21 to -93 nats, p=0.0005 floor, |perm-analytic|<0.03, replication-exact vs parent sha256 8cff7c33b71b092c307a6e41ed021fc0c82b952ed620e571c2f01cf8d5c33be0. Must achieve with exact Dirichlet-Multinomial K=12 (K=24 exploratory) and trajectory-grouped perms: observed log BF >>0, exceeds null by >=200 nats, p_bonf<0.01, |analytic_mean|<0.1 (on BC scale), calibrated_std valid, |perm-analytic|<0.03. Failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (estimator or analytic miscalibrated). Secondary positive: deterministic SPA same design without uniform random (log BF >>0). Code path research/physics/run_experiment.py _dirichlet_multinomial_log_marginal with K=n_states not len(counts), scipy.special.gammaln/polygamma verification logged in provenance.
null_control: Four trajectory-grouped nulls with exact Gamma-ratio DM: (1) Trajectory-grouped permutation null on real WebShop/TodoMVC genuine DOM bank: within-strata shuffle of action labels grouped by trajectory_id 1000-1999 perms seed 42 + exact Gamma-ratio analytic mean/std via gammaln/polygamma; require |analytic_mean|<0.1 nats (on BC scale), calibrated_std>0.01 or analytic_std>0.005, |perm-analytic|<0.03, p_bonf computed min(1,p_raw*n_tests) floor 0.0005. (2) Independent-noise genuine replication: same DOM capture but action-state dependence destroyed via per-step independent within-trajectory shuffle (regime-independent, not S_current%2, same 1280x720 viewport, same K), identical DM+1000 perms; must show |BC|<0.05 p>0.10 |analytic_mean|<0.1. If |BC|>=0.05 p<0.10 valid => MEASUREMENT_INVALID confounded. (3) IID synthetic null (same marginal P(S) independent seed 42) must show |BC|<=0.05 p>0.10. (4) Trajectory-memory diagnostic: time-shuffle destroying lag structure for timescale check if claimed. All executed same K alpha=1/K (K12 primary K24 exploratory), same grouping, locked 1280x720, exact gammaln/polygamma (no heuristic /100*0.1 blending or sqrt(mean(1/(2n))) floor). Audit verifies source contains gammaln/polygamma and not heuristic.
measurement_validity: Substrate: locked 1280x720 via Playwright CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree + DOM.getDocument + DOM.getBoxModel + CSS.getComputedStyleForNode. Reuse existing BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC trajectory banks at 1280x720 if available per intel manifest (50x40 N=1000-1999, DOM/AX already at 1280x720); else collect new WebShop (categories, search, cart, checkout) and TodoMVC at locked 1280x720 with BrowserGym-core 0.14.3 + AgentLab 0.4.2 + Playwright 1.63.0 pinned. No new Gate0 SPA discovery required. Verify viewport 1280x720 dom_bytes>0 a11y_bytes>0 visual_json>0 computed_style dict>0 before claiming genuine; document overlapping spectra verification (style/visual/AX distributions overlap not deterministically regime-color). Not SHA256 hash-truncated single value.

State S_next: SHA256(normalize(URL_after)|'|'|normalize(title_after)|'|'|DOM_cluster_if_needed) normalize(URL)=lowercase strip query ?session=/?token=/?keep SPA hash fragment #/ strip trailing slash; normalize(title)=trim lowercased 200 chars; S_next from t+1 distinct from DOM_before at t (no post-state leak). For URL-only primary, S=URL+title+DOM_cluster? Primary WebShop uses URL+title+DOM_cluster (rich), TodoMVC uses fragment-aware URL as in EXP-PHYSICS-35651906573 but enhanced with genuine DOM stratification. Report |R|/N, H(S_next|C), |S_next| cardinality. K handling: K12 primary; if |S_next|>=16 or observed |S_next|>12, trigger K24 exploratory with same alpha=1/K.

Action A_leakageFree: A=(primitive,target_sig) primitive in {click,fill,navigate,select,submit,hover,type} target_sig=role+name+testId+aria-label+bbox cluster never href/URL/src; diagnostic A_leaky for gap only. MI(DOM;Action)<0.10 else tautology flag. History H_K=2 for Bayesian DM primary? Use state-history K2=(S_current, last 2 URLs or last 2 S) for M0 vs M1 comparison as in EXP-PHYSICS-35651906573. Also test H_K=3 exploratory. Strata key C=(S_current,H_K) with >=5 unique C >=3 per stratum for CMI; H(S_next|C)>0.05 required else degenerate ceiling => MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.

DOM genuine representations (not hash-truncated): R_visual=AX bbox (x,y,w,h quantized 10 bins)+element_count/tree_depth/interactive_density from dom_bytes; R_computed_style=computed CSS 8 values {color,backgroundColor,visibility,display,opacity,border,position,fontSize} from getComputedStyleForNode; R_event_seq=n-gram last 3 primitives; R_AX_embedding=Accessibility.getFullAXTree serialized role/name/value up to 5k + TRAIN-only TF-IDF/embedding k-means 20 clusters or direct AX tree embedding not SHA256 truncated. Preserve raw observables: dom_snapshot, a11y_tree, visual_json, style_dict, event_seq, AX bytes; doc quantization/k/viewport. Primary requires >=1 R genuine.

Estimator: exact Dirichlet-Multinomial marginal likelihood via scipy.special.gammaln and polygamma (digamma polygamma(0), trigamma polygamma(1)): log ML = sum_{cells} [gammaln(K*alpha)-gammaln(N+K*alpha)+ sum_i(gammaln(n_i+alpha)-gammaln(alpha))] with K=n_states (12 primary 24 exploratory) NOT len(counts), alpha_prior in {0.5,1.0, 2.0} primary 1.0 reporting, 0.5/2.0 sensitivity. Log BF = log ML(M1)-log ML(M0) in nats. Analytic null mean/std via exact Gamma-ratio from DM (gammaln/polygamma) not heuristic /100*0.1. BC=observed - analytic_mean. Also compute CMI plug-in bits for gap diagnostics via same strata. Report both nats (BF) and bits (CMI) where applicable; primary gating on nats.

Permutation: 1000-1999 trajectory-grouped shuffles of action labels within each C stratum grouped by trajectory_id seed 42 deterministic; null mean/median/std/p_raw/p_bonf where p_bonf=min(1,p_raw*n_tests) n_tests<=8 floor 0.0005 (effective 2-3 for isomorphic visual/AX noted); resampling unit trajectory_id not transition; no Gaussian jitter; report null_mean, null_std, p_raw, p_bonf, Cohen d=BC/calibrated_std, gap over baselines.

Split integrity: TF-IDF vocab/embedding centroids/Dirichlet counts/k-means fit on TRAIN only (70/30 by trajectory_id); holdout test gaps; site identity never feature; leakage check action.target_href vs URL already filtered but verify MI<0.10. BrowserGym task/site holdout: WebShop vs TodoMVC treated as separate banks not pooled for primary; cross-site exploratory only.

Sampling integrity: policy documented (BrowserGym trajectories as collected with AgentLab, plus locally-hosted 6-state overlapping proxy optional for positive control); PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy 42; never Python hash() as seed; locked 1280x720 viewport; trajectory_id resampling unit.

Uncertainty integrity: trajectory_id unit; correlated transitions not independent; no Gaussian jitter; CI via permutation percentiles; calibrated std = max(analytic_std, perm_std) floor 0.005 analytic /0.01 perm; degeneracy => MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification; heuristic proxy audit rejection documented (|perm-analytic|<0.03).

Representation integrity: raw observables preserved/losses documented (bbox quantization 10 bins, style discretization 8 values, event truncation 3, embedding k=20, AX 5k tokens); derived variables operational meaning validated; MI(DOM;Action)<0.10 tautology check; genuine vs synthetic L-string and vs SHA256 hash-truncated explicitly distinguished; overlapping verification required for barrier interpretation but not for Bayesian detection (still report).

Absolute vs relative BF discipline: absolute observed log BF is exploratory (expected -10 to -15 nats favoring M0 at K12 on real TodoMVC due to K over-penalty on S=3-4 states; report per alpha). Primary gating is RELATIVE: observed exceeds perm null median by >=200 nats and p_bonf<0.01. This distinguishes relative action-structure (real ordering less penalized than shuffled inside deterministic cells) from absolute model preference. Must report both and explicitly label absolute as exploratory not gating.

Auditability: all raw transitions, genuine DOM JSON (bbox/style/event/AX), strata tables, perm+analytic distributions, code paths committed with sha256 in provenance.json; freeze hashes verified before execution (spec/prereg/request sha256 logged); re-executable byte-identical aside elapsed; viewport verified 1280x720; gammaln/polygamma call sites logged via grep verification.

Gate hygiene: bonus gates G1-G6 from parent barrier retained as optional diagnostics but not gating unless stated; primary gates are synthetic positive BC>=200 p<0.01 |analytic|<0.1 cons<0.03, independent BC~0, IID BC~0, H>0.05, viewport genuine, TRAIN-only, trajectory_id grouping.
decision_rule: Gated execution in order; any validity gate triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID and prevents primary SURVIVES/FALSIFIED claim. Gates: G0 synthetic positive fails if observed log BF not >>0 (observed <=0) OR perm p>=0.001 OR |analytic_mean|>=0.1 on BC scale OR calibrated_std degenerate (analytic_std<=0.005 and perm_std<=0.01) OR |perm-analytic|>=0.03 => pipeline blind/miscalibrated to exact Gamma-ratio. G1 independent-noise fails if BC independent |BC|>=0.05 and p<0.10 with valid |analytic|<0.1 => confounded. G2 IID null fails if BC>0.05 p<0.10 valid => null miscentered. G3 H(S_next|C)<=0.05 or N<100 or <5 strata with >=3 => degenerate ceiling. G4 primary |perm-analytic|>=0.03 on primary K12 (both WebShop and TodoMVC banks) => model mismatch. G5 viewport/DOM genuine fails (no dom_bytes/visual/computed/AX >0 or viewport !=1280x720 or SHA256 truncation detected) => substrate missing. G6 TRAIN leakage or trajectory_id not used => split invalid. If any G fails => verdict MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Else primary per real-Web bank (WebShop primary, TodoMVC secondary): for K12 (and K24 if |S_next|>=16) compute M_OBS_BF, M_NULL_MEDIAN/MEAN/STD/MAX, M_ANALYTIC_MEAN/STD, M_CONS=|perm-analytic|, M_REL_SEP= M_OBS - M_NULL_MEDIAN (nats), M_BC= M_OBS - M_ANALYTIC_MEAN, p_raw=(count_ge+1)/(N_perm+1), p_bonf=min(1,p_raw*n_tests) n_tests<=8 floor 0.0005, gaps G_DOM= M_REL_SEP - B_DOM_REL_SEP and G_MARKOV= M_REL_SEP - B_MARKOV_REL_SEP (or BC gaps if baselines on BC scale). sig(bank,K)=1 if M_REL_SEP>=200 nats AND p_bonf<0.01 AND |analytic_mean|<0.1 AND calibrated_std valid (>0.005 analytic or >0.01 perm) AND cons<0.03 AND G_DOM>=0.05 AND G_MARKOV>=0.05 AND independent~0 on that R (|BC|<0.05 p>0.10) AND |R|/N 0.01-0.30 non-degenerate. If EXISTS bank sig==1 => SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST — real Web shows detectable action-conditioned relative structure beyond memory/similarity at exact centering, bounded to that bank/K. Report absolute BF exploratory (-10 to -15 expected favoring memory) separately and do not gate on its sign. If FORALL banks sig fails while gates pass => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING — even correctly centered Bayesian DM with trajectory-grouped permutation shows BC~0 / relative <200 / gap<0.05 on real BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC at 1280x720 with genuine DOM, indicating no detectable beyond-memory action-conditioned relative signal at N=1000-1999 with this representation; physics remains PARKed and Frontier pivots to orthogonal MemoryArena/WebAPI-bypass. Exploratory K24 per-branch BC 0.126 style consistency check reported but not gating unless K12 sig already.
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES with valid exact Gamma-ratio centering (|analytic|<0.1 cons<0.03 calibrated analytic std via gammaln/polygamma) and relative sep >=200 nats p_bonf<0.01 gap>=0.05 over TF-IDF k5 and Markov on >=1 real BrowserGym bank (WebShop or TodoMVC) at 1280x720 with genuine overlapping DOM (visual bbox+computed 8-value+AX embedding) while independent~0 and analytic centered establishes first real-Web action-conditioned relative signal beyond memory, even though absolute BF favors memory (-10 to -15 nats). This bridges synthetic-to-real gap for Bayesian estimator and justifies UNPARKING Physics for production manifest with real session/permission regimes and larger state spaces at 1280x720. Product: distill relative-signal detector as freshness/barrier guard (regime-aware retrieval grouped by latent DOM cluster, visual+AX signature, event-seq guard) into kernel resolve/verify; prioritize BrowserGym session-correlated collection (auth/cart/personalization) where latent regimes amplify relative sep; quantify delta-repair cost when session shifts and cross-site holdout transfer; measure work-compression via relative detector. No generic promotion until absolute BF and transfer validated; report absolute BF separately.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING with valid exact Gamma-ratio gates (analytic |mean|<0.1 cons<0.03 std>0.01) closes Bayesian relative-signal program on existing BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC at N=1000-1999 with genuine DOM at 1280x720: even with correctly centered trajectory-grouped permutation and independent~0, observed log BF does not exceed shuffled null by 200 nats (or p>=0.01 or gap<0.05). Combined with 68 prior C-WEB-DYNAMICS HYPOTHESIS, barrier BC 0.171<0.30 gap 0.011, Bayesian absolute BF -10 to -15 nats favoring memory on TodoMVC, and frontier density blind spots, this confirms real Web at this scale/representation shows at most trivial relative structure beyond memory and physics should remain PARKed pending larger production manifest with real session/permission latent regimes and larger state spaces; Frontier should pivot to orthogonal mechanisms (MemoryArena, WebAPI bypass/compile-execute, tool-bypass). SPIDER must NOT invest in this Bayesian DOM-conditioned dynamics as mechanical prior on 1280x720 BrowserGym at current N; Graph/Product continue via retrieval/verification/repair amortization for C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY. Bounded falsification at N=1000-1999 genuine BrowserGym banks, not global Web closure.
